data.title: Step 5: attack the *weak spots*
data.subtitle: Step 5 of 6 in the self-check loop.

items: Ask for the 3 strongest reasons it's wrong
Ask how your toughest reader reacts
Ask what you'd check to find out

blocks.text: Take the other side. Give me the three strongest reasons this is wrong, and what I'd check to find out.
**You'll get back:** three ranked objections, each with a check you can run.
Use it for recommendations and decisions.

items: Each with a test you can run

blocks.text: An early tester, quoted by Anthropic, says Opus 5.5 "checks its own work in creative ways". Give it a reason to.
